items.title: Gemini 4 Neon + OpenMausBot is CRAZY!
items.summary:
Join this channel to get access to perks:
https://www.youtube.com/channel/@aicodeking/join

In this video, I'll walk through OpenMausBot, an open-source platform for teams of specialist bots, and show how its two-process, local-first setup keeps chats on your machine. I'll cover how it uses your existing Claude Code, Codex, or Grok account with zero token markup, plus its 31 built-in drivers and four-layer Markdown memory for each bot. Then I'll show how bots get hands through boat.dev cloud desktops, a Linux server you bring in BYO VPS mode, Local VM containers, host Cua control, and a three-tier browser. I'll walk through how Rooms route work with Jev or Clef, how to pause bots or departments, and how the CLI, 19-tool MCP server, 500+ Composio apps, five approval modes, automations, phone pairing, and voice calls fit into that workflow. Finally, I'll compare the $0 apps and CLI with paid MausBot Cloud, weigh OpenMausBot against Grok Bot, Meta Muse, OpenAI dots, Cue by Manus, and Inst
